remote.title: Exaviz board on your network
remote.description: Enter the board's IP address or host name. The board needs Exaviz Management with Home Assistant pairing. Use the board's IP address if a .local name does not work.

data_description.update_interval: How often to read PoE port status (10-300 seconds)

fingerprint.title: Check the board's certificate
fingerprint.description:
Start pairing on the board now (More > Home Assistant); the code is valid for 5 minutes.

Compare this fingerprint with the fingerprint on the board's pairing screen:

`{fingerprint}`

Tick the box only if they are the same.

pair.title: Enter the pairing code
pair.description: Enter the 8-character code from the board's pairing screen, like ABCD-EFGH.

repair.title: Pair with the board again
repair.description:
Start pairing on the board now (More > Home Assistant); the code is valid for 5 minutes. Enter the 8-character code, like ABCD-EFGH.

After pairing, revoke the old token `{old_token_id}` on the board in More > Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Change the board's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the board's new IP address or host name. If its certificate changed, you will compare the new fingerprint and pair again.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to detect board hardware. Ensure you are running on an Exaviz Interceptor or Cruiser board.
error.no_poe_detected: No PoE systems detected on this board. Check hardware connections.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
error.missing_packages: Required Exaviz packages (exaviz-dkms, exaviz-netplan) are not installed on the host OS. Install them from the Exaviz apt repository (apt.exaviz.com) before adding this integration.
error.https_required: The board must be reached over HTTPS. Enter the address without http://.
error.invalid_host: Enter only an IP address or host name, optionally with https:// and a port.
error.board_unreachable: The board did not answer. Check the address and that the board is on.
error.no_management: Exaviz Management is not installed on this board.
error.management_too_old: Update Exaviz Management on the board, then try again.
error.unsupported_contract: The board's Exaviz Management is newer than this integration. Update the Exaviz integration.
error.unsupported_board: Only Cruiser boards can be added over the network in this version.
error.invalid_code: The code is wrong, expired or cancelled. Start pairing on the board again and enter the new code.
error.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Wait {retry_after} seconds, start a new pairing on the board, and enter the new code.
error.token_limit: The board already has 20 Home Assistant tokens. Revoke one on the board in More > Home Assistant, then enter the same code again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Exaviz board can be added to Home Assistant in this version.
abort.fingerprint_rejected: The fingerprints were not the same, so nothing was paired. Check that you entered the right board's address.
abort.serial_mismatch: A different board answered. If this board's serial changed, delete the integration and add it again.
abort.board_unreachable: The board did not answer at its saved address. If it moved, use Reconfigure on the Exaviz integration to enter its new address.
abort.reauth_successful: Home Assistant is paired with the board again.
abort.reconfigure_local: This board runs Home Assistant itself, so there is no address to change.
abort.no_management: Exaviz Management is not installed on this board.
abort.management_too_old: Update Exaviz Management on the board, then try again.
abort.unsupported_contract: The board's Exaviz Management is newer than this integration. Update the Exaviz integration.
